hero.title: Audited Against International Environmental Standards
hero.intro: ISO 14001 environmental management, REACH-compliant chemicals and ZDHC-aligned wastewater standards, independently audited across the factory and tannery.
hero.imageAlt: Production line at Kings International, Kanpur

items.title: ISO 14001:2015
items.body: Independently audited environmental management system covering the factory and tannery, from resource use to waste handling.

items.title: REACH Compliance
items.body: Tanning and finishing chemicals are REACH-compliant, supporting safe handling on the factory floor and safe end products for buyers.

items.title: ZDHC-Aligned Wastewater
items.body: Effluent treatment aligned with ZDHC wastewater guidelines, independently assessed by the Central Leather Research Institute (CLRI).

items.title: MSME ZED Gold
items.body: Zero Defect Zero Effect certification held separately for the tannery and leather goods manufacturing divisions.

commitmentsSection.heading: Audited on a recurring schedule, not once.
items: Certificate documents, issuing body, number and audit date provided to buyers on request.
Environmental audits recurring, not one-time - standards maintained order after order.
Chemical inventory and safety data sheets tracked for every tanning and finishing input.
Effluent and emissions monitored against ISO 14001 and ZDHC benchmarks.
